ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) ROKRAT cloud-storage C2 from non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts ROKRAT / DOGCALL / NavRAT beaconing — APT37's signature use of pCloud, Dropbox, Yandex Cloud and Box.com REST APIs as bidirectional C2 (T1102.002) from a process that is not the legitimate desktop client or a browser. No other major nation-state actor relies on pCloud / Yandex Disk APIs at the cadence APT37 does.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest IN ("api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com") OR All_Traffic.dest_url IN ("*api.pcloud.com*","*dropboxapi.com*","*cloud-api.yandex.net*","*upload.box.com*","*api.box.com*")) AND NOT All_Traffic.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","Dropbox.exe","pCloud.exe","Box.exe","BoxDrive.exe","YandexDisk.exe") by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.dest, All_Traffic.dest_ip, All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | where lastTime - firstTime > 600 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let CloudC2 = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com"]);
let LegitClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","Dropbox.exe","DropboxUpdate.exe","pCloud.exe","Box.exe","BoxDrive.exe","YandexDisk.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), HitCount=count(), DistinctUrls=dcount(RemoteUrl), SampleUrls=make_set(RemoteUrl, 8), SampleCmd=any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
          by DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| where datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen) >= 5  // sustained beacon, not one-off
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CloudC2 = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","binapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com"]);
let LegitClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","Dropbox.exe","pCloud.exe","Box.exe","BoxDrive.exe","YandexDisk.exe"]);
let DnsHits = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name has_any (CloudC2)
    | project DnsTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, ResolvedDomain=Name;
DnsHits
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ImageLeaf=tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1])
    | where ImageLeaf !in~ (LegitClients)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, NewProcessName, CommandLine, SubjectUserName, ImageLeaf
) on Computer
| where ProcTime between (DnsTime - 5m .. DnsTime + 1m)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(DnsTime), LastSeen=max(DnsTime), Hits=count(), Domains=make_set(ResolvedDomain,8)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| where datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen) >= 5
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR binapi.pcloud.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR api-content.dropbox.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.com OR upload.box.com OR api.box.com)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\CHROME.EXE OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\FIREFOX.EXE OR *\brave.exe OR *\Brave.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IEXPLORE.EXE OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\DROPBOX.EXE OR *\pCloud.exe OR *\PCLOUD.EXE OR *\Box.exe OR *\BOX.EXE OR *\BoxDrive.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\YANDEXDISK.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api|eapi|binapi)\.pcloud\.com$|^(content|api|api-content)\.dropbox(api)?\.com$|^(cloud-api|webdav)\.yandex\.(net|com)$|^(upload|api)\.box\.com$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|Dropbox|DropboxUpdate|pCloud|Box|BoxDrive|YandexDisk)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)]))
| hits >= 3
ucs.rationale: APT37 / ScarCruft (Ricochet Chollima, InkySquid, Group123) is virtually the only well-documented APT operationalising pCloud REST endpoints (api.pcloud.com / eapi.pcloud.com / binapi.pcloud.com) as bidirectional C2; Talos, Mandiant and Kaspersky have all attributed ROKRAT samples that hard-code these hosts. Pairing the cloud-API destination with a non-client / non-browser parent removes ~all benig

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 HWP/CHM/LNK lure spawns scripting host or LOLBin (ROKRAT delivery chain)
ucs.description: Hunts APT37's South-Korea-focused initial access: a Hangul Word Processor binary (Hwp.exe / Hwp64.exe / Gbb.exe) or an LNK launched via explorer.exe spawning powershell/mshta/wscript/regsvr32 with downloader / encoded-command markers — the documented ROKRAT, CHINOTTO and Konni stager pattern. HWP-parented script execution is essentially exclusive to APT37 because HWP is dominant only in their primary target region.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Hwp.exe","Hwp64.exe","Gbb.exe","HwpApp.exe","explorer.exe","hh.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where (parent_process_name IN ("Hwp.exe","Hwp64.exe","Gbb.exe","HwpApp.exe","hh.exe")) OR match(process, "(?i)(-enc\b|encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|downloadfile|iex\b|invoke-expression|invoke-webrequest|-w\s+h(idden)?|-windowstyle\s+hidden|-nop\b|-noni\b|\.hta\b|javascript:|vbscript:|mshtml|scrobj\.dll|certutil\s+-(decode|urlcache))") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let HwpParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hwp64.exe","gbb.exe","hwpapp.exe","hh.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe"]);
let SusTokens = dynamic(["-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-Expression","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX ","-w h","-WindowStyle hidden","-nop","-noni",".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","scrobj.dll","certutil -decode","certutil -urlcache"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HwpParents) or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe" and FileName in~ (ScriptChildren))
| where FileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HwpParents) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (SusTokens)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandParent=InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ChildImage=FolderPath,
          ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let HwpParents = dynamic(["\\hwp.exe","\\hwp64.exe","\\gbb.exe","\\hwpapp.exe","\\hh.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\mshta.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\rundll32.exe","\\regsvr32.exe","\\certutil.exe","\\bitsadmin.exe","\\curl.exe"]);
let SusTokens = dynamic(["-enc","EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-Expression","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX ","-w h","-WindowStyle hidden","-nop","-noni",".hta","javascript:","vbscript:","scrobj.dll","certutil -decode","certutil -urlcache"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLower=tolower(ParentProcessName), ImageLower=tolower(NewProcessName)
| where ParentLower has_any (HwpParents) or (ParentLower endswith "\\explorer.exe" and ImageLower has_any (ScriptChildren))
| where ImageLower has_any (ScriptChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentLower has_any (HwpParents) or CommandLine has_any (SusTokens)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 HWP / LNK Spawns Scripting Host (ROKRAT Delivery)
id: 8f6c9b1e-4d2a-4f8a-9b3e-7c5f0a2b6d11
status: experimental
description: Detects APT37 (ScarCruft / Reaper / InkySquid / Ricochet Chollima) initial-access chain where a Hangul Word Processor (HWP) document, compiled-help (hh.exe) or LNK launched via explorer.exe spawns a scripting host or LOLBin used to stage ROKRAT / CHINOTTO / Konni.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
author: SOC detection engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_hwp_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hwp64.exe'
      - '\Gbb.exe'
      - '\HwpApp.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  selection_explorer_lnk:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - 'EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - '-w h'
      - '-WindowStyle hidden'
      - '-nop'
      - '.hta'
      - 'scrobj.dll'
      - 'certutil -decode'
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
  condition: selection_hwp_parent or selection_explorer_lnk
falsepositives:
  - Korean-language environments running legitimate HWP automation macros
  - Admin scripts launched via Win+R + history (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\Hwp.exe OR *\HWP.exe OR *\hwp.exe OR *\Hwp64.exe OR *\HWP64.EXE OR *\Gbb.exe OR *\GBB.EXE OR *\HwpApp.exe OR *\hh.exe OR *\HH.EXE OR *\explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\Explorer.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CERTUTIL.EXE OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\BITSADMIN.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *"-w h"* OR *WindowStyle*hidden* OR *.hta* OR *scrobj.dll* OR *certutil*-decode* OR *certutil*-urlcache*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(Hwp|Hwp64|Gbb|HwpApp|hh|explorer)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|cmd|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|curl)\.exe$/i
| (ParentBaseFileName=/^(Hwp|Hwp64|Gbb|HwpApp|hh)\.exe$/i) OR regex("(?i)(-enc\\b|encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|downloadfile|invoke-expression|invoke-webrequest|iex\\b|-w\\s+h(idden)?|-windowstyle\\s+hidden|-nop\\b|\\.hta\\b|javascript:|vbscript:|scrobj\\.dll|certutil\\s+-(decode|urlcache))", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen)]))
ucs.rationale: Hwp.exe / Hwp64.exe (Hancom Hangul Word Processor) parenting a Windows scripting host is essentially pathognomonic for APT37 — HWP is the dominant office suite only in South Korea, which is APT37's primary target. CrowdStrike (Ricochet Chollima), Microsoft (InkySquid), Kaspersky (ScarCruft / Group123) and FireEye/Mandiant (APT37 / Reaper / TEMP.Reaper) all document HWP→PowerShell/mshta/regsvr32 as
